name: Fortaleza Capital
description: Empowering Brazilian businesses through strategic investments.
story: Fortaleza Capital sponsors motorsport to showcase their commitment to performance and precision, mirroring the values they apply to their financial strategies. As a leading Brazilian investment firm, they seek to align with winning teams that demonstrate ambition and a relentless pursuit of excellence. They see motorsport as a platform to enhance brand recognition and build relationships with a high-net-worth audience.
